name: pr-monitor
description: Pane that monitors a repository's open pull requests, merges the ones you mark when they're green, and asks Claude to resolve conflicts in an order that avoids new ones

mergeMethod.title: Merge method
mergeMethod.description: How auto-merge merges a pull request

pollSeconds.title: Refresh every (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often pull request state is read from GitHub (minimum 20)

autoOpen.title: Open the pane at session start
autoOpen.description: Opens the monitor when a session starts in a repository with open pull requests

maxResolveAttempts.title: Conflict resolution attempts
maxResolveAttempts.description: Automatic resolution attempts per pull request before it's handed back to you
